title: Exponent rules
status: draft: written by Claude, waiting for owner review
about: Teacher-verified mastery check. Written separately from the practice generators: different wordings, word problems, and an 'is this right?' item. Each item is worth 1 point. 'math' is the calculation in JavaScript form, used only by the test that checks the answer key: 'exponent: <expr>' (the key is a power of x with that exponent), 'value: <expr>' (the key is that number), 'between: <n>' (the key names the two whole numbers around √n), 'kind: rational|irrational', 'sci: <mantissa> <exponent>' (the key is mantissa × 10^exponent).
directions: Simplify. Write answers with positive exponents or as numbers.

items.prompt: A bacteria colony doubles every hour, so after h hours it is 2ʰ times as big. How many times as big is it after 0 hours? Explain.
Ravi says 4⁻² = −16. Is he right? Explain, and find the value.
items.answer: 1/16 (No: a negative exponent means one over, 1/4²)

items.prompt: A cube with sides of 10 cm has a volume of 10³ cm³. A small cube has sides of 10⁻¹ cm. What is the small cube's volume, as a fraction?
Lena simplified x⁴ · x³ and got x¹². Is she right? Explain, and simplify it correctly.
items.answer: x⁷ (No: multiplying powers adds the exponents)
